digest.component_or_area: Jira family reconciliation adapter (Cloud + Data Center)
propositions: rebar cannot reconcile against self-hosted Jira Data Center due to REST v2 vs v3, wiki-markup vs ADF, PAT vs ACLI auth, and name vs accountId user identity differences
PR #120's second adapter package reached into Cloud adapter privates and forked map_fields_to_remote, creating unmaintained duplication of mapping logic across adapters
a shared jira_family sub-seam consolidates field mappings, value maps, label/link sanitizers, and shared contracts without moving location-pinned modules or breaking the Cloud path

Jira Data Center PAT authentication requires https by default, rejects cleartext base_url unless allow_insecure override is set, never disables certificate verification, and reads credentials from JIRA_PAT environment only
rebar must parameterize rich-text encoding and user identity model per deployment (ADF/accountId for Cloud, wiki-text/name for DC) rather than forking implementations
reconciler.resolved_statuses is a configurable list of workflow state names that DC passes to the absence classifier, defaulting to Cloud's {Resolved, Done, Cancelled} for backward compatibility
